title: Council prescribed workflow
basis: council/SKILL.md: frozen packet, five independent Luna roles, completion gate, Sol synthesis, parent fidelity check
description: The first Codex node distributes a frozen task to five Luna advisors, ordered top to bottom as Strategist, Skeptic, Creative, Operator and Audience Advocate. Valid briefs pass the five-role gate before reaching Sol. Sol synthesizes and the final Codex node checks fidelity to the original request and briefs. This is an instruction-defined workflow, not execution or performance evidence.
